title: Warhammer 40,000: Glory in Death
notes: The logos take about 45 seconds; then the title waits for key 5. Left alone for a quarter of a minute, the title loads a demo battle; a key press brings the title back.
A quick battle: Main Menu > Skirmish, then choose Done on each setup screen (Up from the top of a list jumps to Done), read the briefing and press 5.
A battle starts with deployment: 5 on a unit's card opens the grid, the pad moves the unit and 5 places it.
Either soft key pauses a battle (resume, save, audio settings, quit). In the pause menu the left soft key selects; OK does not.
The main menu also has a Tutorial. Multiplayer needs a second phone and cannot work here.

controls.source: Seen by pressing keys in the menus and in the deployment phase of a skirmish battle; the title screen itself says to press key 5. The game's Tutorial and the later phases of a turn (moving, shooting, ending the turn) were not gone through, so keys used only there are missing.

actions.up: Move the cursor or the unit being placed; move the selection in menus
actions.down: Move the cursor or the unit being placed; move the selection in menus
actions.left: Move the cursor or the unit being placed
actions.right: Move the cursor or the unit being placed
actions.5: Start from the title; select and confirm (place a unit)
actions.ok: Select in menus; continue from the briefing and the turn banner
actions.lsk: Select in menus; pause in a battle
actions.rsk: Back in menus; pause in a battle

statusNote: Runs from the logos to the title and main menu, through the Skirmish setup screens and the mission briefing into a battle: the map is drawn, turn 1 starts with the deployment phase, units are placed on the grid with the pad and 5, and the pause menu works.
